description: The authoritative current Mass Mobilization dataset, country universe, schema, reuse terms and additional official Coding Procedure were not verified for this unit. Ccode 390 remains provisional; all candidate IDs and eligibility decisions are local worker proposals.
required_followup: Coordinator should verify the official baseline bytes, codebook/Coding Procedure, universe, schema and reuse terms before any mapping or integration.

description: The Jan 12 construction-worker gathering clearly supported private-sector negotiators and raised wage/social-dumping bargaining demands. A proposed holiday abolition and working hours were described as important issues, but the opened account does not attribute a direct government demand to this gathering.
required_followup: Find an original participant/organizer statement or independent contemporary report that distinguishes a Danish government-policy demand from private employer bargaining.

description: Only Netavisen Pio’s Jan 12 body was opened for the construction-worker event. Solidaritet was technically inaccessible; Arbejderen, Fagbladet 3F and DI are search-only leads and have not been compared for shared text, agency or direct observation.
required_followup: If permitted by fresh exact-URL checks, inspect the relevant original bodies and record direct observation, syndication and organizational interests before treating accounts as independent.

description: The Jan 21 Louis Vuitton lead is search-only and the first exact-URL body request returned Cache miss; the snippet says only “a group.” The Jan 28 Max Mara accounts also give no physical count. Neither fur gathering is shown to meet 50 participants.
required_followup: Seek a lawful, fresh-receipt-checked contemporary source that counts physical participants at each site; do not infer attendance from photographs or article wording alone.

description: The fur-action reports identify private retailer targets and opposition to fur use, but no demand to the Danish government or its policy. The local provisional category list has no animal-welfare/fur demand category.
required_followup: Review full organizer materials or contemporary coverage for an explicit Danish state-policy demand; if none is documented, retain these as private-target exclusions after review.

description: S011 describes the Jan 21 Louis Vuitton action as a previous-weekend action with the same message as Jan 28 Max Mara. Identity, organizers and continuity are not established. The same issue does not by itself justify merging local dates/sites.
required_followup: Check dated organizer records and December/February boundaries for shared organization or distinct actions; keep the two dates/sites separate unless evidence supports a documented episode decision.

description: For the Jan 28 Max Mara action, Presse-fotos describes a calm gathering and police presence for order; Arbejderen reports an abrupt forceful ending, an administrative detention and shoves. No primary police or video evidence was reviewed.
required_followup: Obtain an independent primary account or additional contemporary reporting and preserve source attribution; verify exact response and physical end time without treating shoves as a beating.

description: Paludan’s three site stops and a possible Soundbox counter-action are described, but no Danish government-policy demand is established. At the first site, about 100 people are described as watching without roles separated; later site participant counts are absent.
required_followup: For any reconsideration, distinguish demonstrator(s), counter-demonstrators, supporters, spectators and police at each site; establish an actual 50-person assembly and a demand on Danish policy.

description: S001 (Solidaritet) and S018 (Presse-fotos LV) returned technical Cache miss errors; S001’s ordinary HTTPS attempt failed at DNS without HTTP. AP-linked S012/S013 remain under the inherited Associated Press hold and were not requested. DR/TV2 domain searches returned robots.txt errors only; no source-page denial is claimed.
required_followup: Preserve the AP hold. For technical failures, use only a new exact-URL receipt and manual review before any later attempt; do not relabel technical errors as denial. Seek accessible permitted Danish reporting for the open leads.

description: This is a bounded Danish/English open-web pass, not a LexisNexis-equivalent archive search or an absence finding. There was no systematic review of local/regional print archives, union records, Greenlandic/Faroese materials or all Danish-language regional outlets. DR and TV2 site searches failed at the tool’s robots boundary.
required_followup: A reviewer should extend coverage through permitted local/regional and sector archives, and document language/outlet limits and unsuccessful searches without inferring that no other events occurred.
